summary: A candidate for a local seat files with the county elections office, and must be a registered voter in the district.
realLife: The state office handles state and federal filings and tells candidates to contact the county elections office for other offices; online filers must be registered in the district.
sources: Washington Secretary of State, File for Office: https://www.sos.wa.gov/elections/candidates/filing-resources/file-office
inGame: the filing records (clerk, registrar or board of elections from the place's own records), as the director reads for the filing visit.
